description: IN: S03’s amber zero-line hum continues (same line, same tone)
an arrowhead grows on the right end of the line
the line swings up −90° to vertical (peak of the swing ~f40)
gold dust starts streaming out of the tail point (granular stream, rising until f104)
width bracket 1 measures the plume
width bracket 2
width bracket 3
width bracket 4 (widest, near the arrowhead)
the flow clock stalls (pitch slows to zero at f104)
◀◀ appears top-left, chromatic split on the dust
the dust runs backward and narrows into the tail (reversed granular stream)
the camera dives into the tail point (accelerating rush until f186)
the last dust is swallowed by the tail point — soft gathered thump, the point flares
the tail point opens (iris with a gold rim) onto the present-day cosmos
falling Shepard tone starts (cosmic rewind, until the slam at f288)
the merger remnant starts to un-merge (low rumble until f240)
monumental counter appears: 1 天
odometer clicks accelerate into a whirr (1天 → 年 → 万年 → 亿年, until f286)
first stars un-light (reversed plinks; cluster un-ignitions 196–216)
un-ignition cluster
un-ignition cluster (densest)
un-ignition cluster
last stars go out
the dark ages: everything dims for a beat
the heat surge: red → orange → white-hot plasma (roar builds until f274)
the counter lands on 138 亿年
SLAM — the floor of time: flash, shock ring, camera shake
the counter flies into the HUD (◀◀ 138亿年)
boiling plasma bed (sustained until the darkness at f376)
HUD types 涨落 ×10⁵ 放大
darkness falls over the plasma (low-pass)
the base “10” punches in, bursting out of frame (plasma inside the glyph)
exponent “10” pops (higher pitch)
exponent “123” pops (higher still)
note 彭罗斯估算 types in
camera pulls back to the whole fraction
the fraction bar draws, 1 and 概率 ≈ appear
the wall of zeros types in, accelerating into a crackle/whirr (until f512)
the darkness lifts: the uniform plasma returns
the temperature probe draws its flat trace (thin sine, steady pitch = uniform)
whiteout of the plasma
dissolve into S01’s spent ink: underwater hush, cream light table
S墨 appears at the TOP of the gauge, S宇宙 at the bottom — the contradiction
the two thought-experiment boxes draw on in ink
the gas in both boxes jiggles (soft)
the whole spent-ink universe starts to gather (deep swell until f726)
gravity on: the right box’s gas falls together
first light sparks leave the heated clump (sparks continue to ~f730)
the clump settles (soft thud); its S tick has climbed
left box slides away, right box swells to fill the frame
the paper goes dark from the bottom up: ink becomes light (sub drop, until f746)
▶ 38万年
deep swell of the ignition era (until f800)
▶ 2亿年
first star ignites (centre-bottom cluster): flash + shock ring + spikes
ignition cascade (3 clusters)
ignition cascade (6 clusters)
ignition
heaviest on-screen cluster ignites (left, y≈1000)
ignition (top right)
ignition
groups ignite (second, finer wave of sparkles until ~f795)
▶ 10亿年
滚落 slides down the slope (second glyph f789)
▶ 50亿年
之后 rises with its trail
▶ 现在
HUD and gauge fade out
0.6 s still on the lit web: sustained chord, no new events; cut is continuous into S05
